statement: Three runtimes carry a skills mirror and each shape is runtime-constrained: .claude/skills and .pi/skills are whole-dir symlinks to ../.opencode/skills, while .hermes/skills holds 68 generated markdown-only copies because Hermes's static scanner quarantines symlinked directories (a whole-tree link cost ten minutes per session and quarantined every hub).

Hermes's 68 skill directories are 56 canonical SKILL.md copies plus 12 agent-<name> persona skills; the 56 reconciles exactly against a live count, because Hermes has no agent-file flag and a plugin prompt section is capped at 4000 characters.

Hermes has a live partial failure inside its generated mirror: only 61 of 68 skills load, because Hermes's own prose scanner quarantines 7 and excludes them from both 'skills list' and '-s'; the generator's --check cannot detect this, so green --check does not imply loadable skills.

Cursor's missing .cursor/skills is correct by nature (Cursor's skills live in ~/.cursor/skills-cursor/ and are Cursor-managed); the compensating affordance is the hand-authored .cursor/rules/skill-routing.md, whose packet list has no generator and will not pick up a new skill packet automatically.

Codex has no .codex/skills and no .codex/commands; its surface inventory enumerates seven surfaces with no skills row, and the equivalent affordance is 35 generated pointer-stub prompts plus a hand-authored AGENTS.md. Correct by nature, with the causal half inferred: the manifest asserts the absent directory without naming a missing loader capability.
Devin needs no skills mirror: it discovers .opencode/skills/* natively as slash commands, recorded in iteration 2 and re-confirmed at .devin/SYNC.md:20.
Documentation drift: .cursor/SYNC.md:32 claims commands/*.md (36); the live tree holds 35 (33 symlinks + goal-cursor.md + vision.md). The manifest a maintainer would trust overstates its own mirror.

sync-skills-hermes.cjs --check exists and is documented but is invoked by neither the pre-commit hook nor any workflow, joining sync-prompts-hermes.cjs --check and sync-prompts-pi.cjs --check as the third unwired drift mode.

Whether the Codex CLI has any skill loader at all is inferred from an absence assertion in its SYNC manifest, not from the runtime's own contract. Confirming check: enumerate Codex's loader surfaces (config keys, --help, documentation).
